newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says ready to help troubled banks case-by-case.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says ready to help troubled banks case-by-case.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Tuesday that the central bank was prepared to provide necessary funds to troubled financial institutions on a case-by-case basis.
The BOJ could not extend funds to make up for bank losses but had been extending liquidity when the need arose, he said.
It was in this context that the central bank extended funds to help Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's restructuring plans, he said.

"We should decide (on whether to extend funds) by taking into consideration how much a problem would affect the overall financial industry and whether it is possible to restructure the financial institution concerned," he said.
"We would like to reach our decisions regarding BOJ funds carefully and on a case-by-case basis," he added.
